00_README.__EMPTY: Reference data for populating a Nucleus demo tenant. Every record is engineered so that one or more of the 26 client demo points can be shown live, end to end.
Vindhya Precision Industries Pvt Ltd — a fictional multi-state manufacturer. Two legal entities, five sites, four states, 68 workers across nine worker classes.
Attendance and transactions are dated 01–15 September 2026. Payroll cycle is September 2026. Set the demo tenant clock to 15 September 2026 so open items sit in the right state.
Load sheets in the numbered order. 02–19 are master and configuration data and must exist before any transaction sheet will import.
Enter the data exactly as given. The values are not arbitrary — thresholds, times, dates and amounts are chosen so the expected results in sheet 21 are reproduced by the product.

After loading, run the attendance computation for 01–15 September and reconcile against sheet 21 (21_Expected_Attendance). Any row where the product disagrees with the expected status is a defect to fix before the demo, not a data error.
Sheet 01_Scenario_Map is the demo script. It names, for each of the 26 client points, the exact records to open on screen and what the client should see.
